meta.title: WheatFHB Atlas
meta.assembly: IWGSC Chinese Spring RefSeq v1.0 (v1.1 annotation convention)
meta.scope: bread wheat nuclear chromosomes 1A–7D; alien segments kept separate
meta.coverageNote: Zheng et al. report 625 collected original QTL in the abstract, 613 original QTL in the discussion of the meta-analysis, and 624 chromosome-tagged rows in the public Table S1 file used here. These may represent different filtering stages, but the current release does not assume they are interchangeable. It preserves the 624 mappable rows and exposes the count difference for recheck.
meta.coordinateNote: All chromosome drawings use RefSeq v1.0 lengths. Original-QTL physical coordinates are later projections reported by Zheng et al. 2021, not direct physical intervals from every original study. Reversed left/right coordinates in legacy tables are normalized with a flag. Alien introgressions and genetic-only intervals are not forced onto Chinese Spring physical coordinates.
meta.impactNote: Impact factor is a journal-level metric with a displayed year and source; it is not an evidence-quality score. Missing values are left blank.
meta.metaEvidenceNote: Table S5 reports the count of original QTL consolidated into each mQTL but does not publish record-level membership. Candidate links shown by the atlas are reproducible genetic-CI overlaps against Table S1 and must not be interpreted as the exact BioMercator membership set.
meta.auditNote: v0.5.0 freezes 653 checked locus records from 52 study units. The map and batch-SNP analysis draw only 234 strict-primary RefSeq v1.0-comparable loci; all retained non-primary rows, coordinate audits, lifecycle links, and factual curation labels remain downloadable.
